en.title: Monitoring Registered Participants
en.excerpt: Managing the participant roster, filtering athletes by division or club, verifying medical info, and spreadsheet exports.

toc.text: Filtering by Division, Club, and Status

en.content:
Centralized Participant Roster

Navigate to Tournament Dashboard > Participants to access the complete master table of all registered archers. The table displays registration timestamp, athlete name, club affiliation, category, payment status, and assigned target butt.

Filtering by Division, Club, and Status

Use the top toolbar to filter large participant rosters:

  • Category Filter: View athletes within a specific division (e.g., Recurve Men Senior).
  • Payment Status: Isolate Paid/Verified, Pending Payment, or Cancelled entries.
  • Club / Contingent: Filter all athletes registered under a single club banner for collective verification.

Reviewing Athlete Details & Emergency Contacts

Click on any athlete row to view emergency contact numbers, date of birth, bow specifications, and official payment receipts.

Exporting Registration Data to Excel

Click Export CSV / Excel in the top action bar to download a comprehensive spreadsheet for physical check-in desks, equipment inspection stations, and committee records.
